z-m-13-03.title: Ruwan 3/4 L, kwalabe 1/6 L: wane labari ya dace?
z-m-13-03.topic: Raba kasro: zaɓar labarin da ya dace da alamar lissafi da ƙirƙirar yanayi da za a cika ba tare da saura ba.
z-m-13-03.goal: Ka faɗi ko labari ya dace da ma'anar kasro ÷ kasro ta 'sau nawa adadi ɗaya yake shiga cikin wani'; ƙirƙiri yanayi da za a cika gaba ɗaya ba tare da saura ba, kuma idan amsar rabo kasro ce ka fassara ainihin kwalaben da ake buƙata bisa tambaya.
z-m-13-03.material: Seoyeon tana son ƙirƙirar labarin da ya dace da 3/4 ÷ 1/6. Labari guda ɗaya ko da dama na iya dacewa da alama ɗaya. Da farko za ka zaɓi wanda ya dace cikin labarai huɗu, sannan ka ƙirƙiri labari da kanka.
z-m-13-03.thinking.0: Zaɓar yanayi da ya dace da ma'anar alamar lissafi.
z-m-13-03.thinking.2: Fahimtar ƙimar rabo da ainihin adadin da ake buƙata a matsayin abubuwa dabam.
z-m-13-03.prereq.0: Dandanon tunanin rabo a matsayin 'sau nawa adadi ɗaya ya shiga wani'.
z-m-13-03.prereq.1: Ma'anar kasro da kasro da ba za a ƙara ragewa ba (matakin aji na 5).
z-m-13-03.s.s1.prompt: Seoyeon tana son yin labari da ya dace da 3/4 ÷ 1/6. Wane labari ne amsarsa ƙimar wannan alamar? (3/4 ana karanta shi uku cikin huɗu, 1/6 ɗaya cikin shida.)
z-m-13-03.s.s1.hint.0: Ga kowane labari, rubuta adadin da 3/4 da 1/6 kowannensu yake nufi.
z-m-13-03.s.s1.hint.1: Duba ɗaya bayan ɗaya ko labarin yana tambayar sau nawa 1/6 yake shiga 3/4.
z-m-13-03.s.s1.o.a: Idan mutane 6 suka raba ruwan 3/4 L daidai, kaso na mutum ɗaya.
z-m-13-03.s.s1.r.a: Wannan labari ne na raba ruwan daidai tsakanin mutane 6 (3/4 ÷ 6). 1/6 ba adadin mutane ba ne, adadin da ke cikin kwalba guda ne.
z-m-13-03.s.s1.o.b: Idan aka sha 1/6 na 3/4 L na ruwa, adadin da aka sha.
z-m-13-03.s.s1.r.b: Wannan labari ne na tambayar nawa ne 1/6 na 3/4 (3/4×1/6). Ba ya tambayar sau nawa 1/6 ya shiga 3/4.
z-m-13-03.s.s1.o.c: Idan aka zuba ruwan 3/4 L cikin kwalaben 1/6 L, adadin kwalabe.
z-m-13-03.s.s1.o.d: Idan aka haɗa ruwan 3/4 L da 1/6 L, jimillar adadi.
z-m-13-03.s.s1.r.d: Wannan labari ne na haɗa adadi biyu (3/4+1/6). Ba ya tambayar sau nawa adadi ɗaya yake shiga wani.
z-m-13-03.s.s1.explain: Labarin da ke tambayar sau nawa ruwan 1/6 L yake shiga 3/4 L ya dace da 3/4÷1/6. Ƙimar ita ce 9/2, wato 4 da 1/2. Ana iya nuna rabo ta nau'o'in labari biyu: 'raba daidai' (partitive) da 'sau nawa adadi ya shiga wani' (quotative); tunda 1/6 a wannan alamar adadin ruwa ne a kwalba guda, ba adadin mutane ba, nau'i na biyu ya dace.
z-m-13-03.s.s2.prompt: A wannan karon, yi labari kamar na Seoyeon. Kana son cika kwalabe 1/c L (c lambar ƙasan kwalba ce) gaba ɗaya da ruwan n/d L (n lambar sama, d ƙasa), babu saura. Ruwa kasro ne da ba za a ƙara ragewa ba kuma ya gaza 1 L, d bai fi 12 ba, c kuma cikakkiyar lamba ce daga 2 zuwa 12. Aƙalla kwalabe 2 ake buƙata. Yi yanayi mabambanta guda 3.
z-m-13-03.s.s2.hint.0: Zaɓi adadin ruwa, canza girman kwalba, ka ƙirga sau nawa adadin kwalba ɗaya yake shiga ruwan.
z-m-13-03.s.s2.hint.1: 3/4 L da 1/6 L ba su cika kwalaben gaba ɗaya ba. Duba girman kwalban da zai yi daidai.

z-m-13-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Ruwan kasro ne da ba za a ƙara ragewa ba, ya gaza 1 L.
z-m-13-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Adadin ruwa n/d ba kasro ba ne da ba za a ƙara ragewa ba, wanda ya gaza 1 L.

z-m-13-03.s.s2.fail.c4: Kwalba ɗaya ta isa. Gwada ƙaramin kwalba (ƙara c).
z-m-13-03.s.s2.explain: Sau nawa 1/c yake shiga ruwan n/d shi ne n×c÷d. Wannan ƙimar dole cikakkiyar lamba ce domin kwalaben su cika gaba ɗaya. Misali, 3/4 L a kwalaben 1/4 L kwalabe 3 ne; 2/3 L a kwalaben 1/3 L kwalabe 2; 1/2 L a kwalaben 1/6 L kwalabe 3. 3/4 L a kwalaben 1/6 L ya zama kwalabe 4 da rabin kwalba, don haka ba a cika su gaba ɗaya ba.
z-m-13-03.s.s3.prompt: 3/4÷1/6=9/2, wato 4 da 1/2. Kana son zuba duk ruwan 3/4 L cikin kwalaben 1/6 L. Kwalbar da rabinta kawai ya cika har yanzu ana ƙirga ta a matsayin kwalba guda. Aƙalla kwalabe nawa ake buƙata?
z-m-13-03.s.s3.hint.0: Bayyana da kalmomi abin da 4 da 1/2 a cikin amsar rabo 4 da 1/2 kowanne yake nufi ga kwalaben.
z-m-13-03.s.s3.hint.1: Nemo ko akwai ruwa da ya rage bayan cikawa, ka yanke ko ana buƙatar ƙarin kwalba ga wannan ruwan.
z-m-13-03.s.s3.r.b: 4 yana ƙirga cikakkun kwalabe kawai. Ana buƙatar ƙarin kwalba ɗaya ga ragowar ruwa 1/12 L.
z-m-13-03.s.s3.r.c: Ba za a iya yanka kwalba guntu-guntu ba. Dole ne ka yi tunanin ƙimar lambar (rabo) da ainihin adadin kwalaben da ake buƙata daban.
z-m-13-03.s.s3.r.d: 9 lambar sama ce a amsar rabo 9/2. Dole ne ka karanta kasron a matsayin 4 da 1/2, sannan ka yanke adadin kwalabe.
z-m-13-03.s.s3.explain: Amsar rabo 4 da 1/2 tana nufin kwalabe 4 cikakku da rabin kwalba ƙari. Ruwan da ya rage shi ne 3/4−4×1/6=1/12 L (adadin rabin kwalba), ana buƙatar kwalba domin wannan ma, saboda haka kwalabe 5 gaba ɗaya. Idan tambayar 'kwalabe nawa ne cikakku' ce, 4 ne; idan 'kwalabe nawa ake buƙata' ce, 5 ne. Amsar rabo ɗaya tana da fassara dabam bisa tambaya.

z-m-13-08.title: Gwada “hanyar da ake amfani da ita kawai idan rabo ya fito ba tare da saura ba” ta Gaon
z-m-13-08.topic: Raba kaso: iyakar yanayin da hanyar nemo kaso mai suna ɗaya da raba marubuta take aiki
z-m-13-08.goal: Ka gwada ikirarin cewa hanyar nemo kaso mai suna ɗaya da raba marubuta ana iya amfani da ita “kawai idan rabo ya fito ba tare da saura ba” ta amfani da misalin da ya karyata ikirarin, sannan ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa za a iya amfani da wannan hanya a kowane hali.
z-m-13-08.material: A raba kaso, akwai hanyar nemo kaso mai suna ɗaya na kaso biyun sannan a raba marubutansu. Misali, 4/5 ÷ 2/5 suna da suna ɗaya, saboda haka 4 ÷ 2 = 2. Yayin da ake amfani da wannan hanyar, Gaon ya ce, ‘Ana iya amfani da hanyar nemo kaso mai suna ɗaya da raba marubuta ne kawai idan marubutan suna rabuwa ba tare da saura ba. Idan ba su rabu haka ba, kada a yi amfani da wannan hanyar.’ (Ana karanta 4/5 da “huɗu bisa biyar”, 2/5 kuma da “biyu bisa biyar”.)
z-m-13-08.thinking.0: Yanke shawarar irin misalin da zai iya karyata ikirari

z-m-13-08.prereq.1: Sauya rabon kaso zuwa ninkawa (matakin aji na 6)

Saboda haka nemo irin waɗannan misalai da kwatanta su da ƙimar da aka samu ta ninkawa da akasin kaso shi ne ya fi taimako.

z-m-13-02.title: Ƙa'idar sauya kasro zuwa decimal don lissafi: har ina take daidai?
z-m-13-02.topic: Lissafi mai haɗa kasro da decimal: yaushe ya dace a canza kasro zuwa decimal?
z-m-13-02.goal: Yi hukunci, kana daidaita amincewarka duk lokacin da sabon bayani ya zo, waɗanne kasro ƙa'idar sauyawa zuwa decimal take bayarwa daidai, waɗanne kuma kusan kawai; rubuta sharadin a saƙo da ƙani zai karanta.
z-m-13-02.material: Seoha ta ce, 'Idan ana lissafi da kasro da decimal a haɗe, sauya duk kasrorin zuwa decimal ya fi sauƙi. Za ka iya rubuta 1/3 a matsayin 0.33 kawai.' Ana bayyana sakamakon lissafi ɗaya bayan ɗaya domin ganin yadda ƙa'idar Seoa ke aiki. (Ana karanta 1/3 'ɗaya cikin uku', 5/6 kuma 'biyar cikin shida'.)

z-m-13-02.thinking.1: Bambanta ƙimomi daidai da ƙimomi kusan.
z-m-13-02.thinking.2: Sake faɗin gama-gari ta ƙara sharudda.
z-m-13-02.prereq.0: Rubuta kasro a decimal (matakin aji na 5, kamar 1/4=0.25).
z-m-13-02.prereq.2: Zagayawa zuwa wurin decimal na biyu.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.prompt: Ana bayyana sakamakon lissafi ɗaya bayan ɗaya. Kowace rana zaɓi yadda za a ɗauki ƙa'idar Seoha.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.hint.0: A kowane mataki, rubuta sakamakon lissafin da aka yi da decimal da na kasro gefe da gefe, yi alama inda suka yi daidai da inda suka bambanta.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.hint.1: Kwatanta yadda lambobin bayan maki goma ke ƙarewa idan aka rubuta 1/4 da 1/3 a decimal (ko sun tsaya ko sun ci gaba har abada).
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.0.info: Lissafi na farko 1/4+0.5 ne. Seoha ta sauya 1/4=0.25, ta samu 0.25+0.5=0.75. Da kasro, 1/4+1/2=3/4, 3/4 kuma 0.75 ne.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.0.ask: Yaya za ka ɗauki ƙa'idar Seoha?
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.0.after: Samun amsa ɗaya ba ya nuna haka ne ga duk kasro. 1/4 kasro ce da ke zama 0.25 daidai. Gwada wasu kasro shi ne mataki na gaba da ya dace.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Sakamakon lissafin iri ɗaya ne, saboda haka amsar iri ɗaya ce ga kowace kasro.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ka ɗauki misali guda kaɗai ka yi tsalle zuwa 'kowace kasro'. Yi tunanin ko akwai kasro kamar 1/3 da ke bambanta idan aka sauya zuwa decimal.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Misali guda ba zai faɗa mana ba. Gwada wasu kasro ma.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wannan hukunci ne mai kyau. Misali ɗaya da ya yi daidai ya bambanta da 'koyaushe daidai', saboda haka kana buƙatar gwada ƙari.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ƙa'idar Seoha ba daidai ba ce. Idan aka sauya kasro zuwa decimal, ƙimarta tana canzawa.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ko da aka sauya 1/4 zuwa 0.25, ƙimar ba ta canza ba. Bincika ko akwai kasro da ƙimarta ke canzawa idan aka sauya ta.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Ba za a iya yin lissafin da ya haɗa kasro da decimal ta kowace hanya ba.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Za ka iya daidaita su, kasro da kasro ko decimal da decimal. A wannan misalin hanyoyin biyun duk sun yiwu.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.1.info: Lissafi na biyu 1/3+0.5 ne. Seoha ta sauya 1/3=0.33, ta samu 0.33+0.5=0.83. Da kasro, 1/3+1/2=5/6, 5/6 idan aka rubuta decimal 0.8333… ne (3 ɗin yana ci gaba har abada).
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.1.ask: Yaya ya kamata a ɗauki amsar Seoha 0.83?
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.1.after: Idan aka zagaya 0.8333… zuwa wurin decimal na biyu, 0.83 ne. Don haka idan matsalar tana buƙatar 'har zuwa wurin decimal na biyu', amsar Seoha za a iya karɓa. Amma ainihin ƙimar 5/6 ce, 0.83 kuma kusan ƙima ce ɗan ƙasa da ita. Da farko duba irin daidaiton da matsalar ke buƙata.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.1.o.a: 5/6 ba 0.83 ba ne, saboda haka amsar Seoha kuskure ce ko da yaushe.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Gaskiya ne 5/6 wata lamba ce dabam da 0.83, amma idan matsalar tana buƙatar 'har zuwa wurin decimal na biyu', 0.83 na iya zama amsa.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.1.o.b: 0.83 da 0.8333… ainihin lamba ɗaya ce, babu buƙatar bambanta su.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.1.r.b: 0.8333… lamba ce da 3 ke ci gaba har abada, don haka ta ɗan fi 0.83 girma. Ba lamba ɗaya ba ne.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.1.o.c: A matsayin ƙimomi daidai sun bambanta, amma idan ana buƙatar wurin decimal na biyu, 0.83 ma ya dace.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ka bambanta ƙimomi daidai da na kusan, ka gane ya danganta da daidaiton da matsalar ke nema.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Seoha ta mayar da shi 0.33, wannan ne matsalar, saboda haka ba za a iya lissafa 0.33+0.5 ba.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Ana iya lissafa 0.33+0.5. Matsalar ita ce 1/3 da aka mayar zuwa 0.33 ba ainihin ƙimar ba ce.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.2.info: Lissafi na uku shi ne haɗa 1/3 sau uku. Seoha ta samu 0.33+0.33+0.33=0.99. Da kasro, 1/3+1/3+1/3=1.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.2.ask: Me wannan sakamakon yake nuna mana?
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.2.after: Ƙaramin bambancin da ya zo daga rubuta 1/3 a matsayin 0.33 ya ƙaru zuwa 0.01 idan aka haɗa sau uku. Yayin da lissafi ya ci gaba, bambancin na iya taruwa, don haka idan ana buƙatar ainihin ƙima, lissafin kasro yadda yake ya fi aminci.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.2.o.a: 0.99 da 1 kusan ɗaya ne, saboda haka ƙa'idar Seoha ta dace ko'ina.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Kalmomin 'kusan ɗaya' ba su faɗi kusancin da ake buƙata ba. A matsalar da ke buƙatar ainihin ƙima, 0.99 ba 1 ba ne.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Ba za a iya rubuta 1/3 a matsayin decimal ba, saboda haka kada a haɗa kasro da decimal.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ana iya rubuta 1/3 a matsayin decimal inda 3 ke ci gaba har abada. Haɗa su ba haramun ba ne da kansa.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Ƙa'idar Seoha ba ta taɓa yin daidai ba tukuna.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.2.r.c: A 1/4+0.5, hanyar Seoha ta ba da ainihin ƙima ma.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Ƙananan kuskure suna ci gaba da taruwa, saboda haka idan ana buƙatar ainihin ƙima, yi lissafin da kasro.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Ka karanta yadda ƙananan kurakurai suke taruwa ta hanyar haɗawa da ninkawa.
z-m-13-02.s.s1.reflect: Shin ƙa'idar Seoha ta yi kama da daidai a farko? Yayin da misalai suka bayyana ɗaya bayan ɗaya, waɗanne tunani suka canza, waɗanne suka tsaya? Me za ka duba don gane ko ana buƙatar ainihin ƙima ko kusan ƙima ta isa?
z-m-13-02.s.s2.prompt: Kana son gaya wa ƙaninka game da hanyar Seoha. Rubuta masa ɗan gajeren saƙo da misalan kasro, ka faɗi lokacin da ya dace a yi amfani da hanyar da kuma lokacin yin taka-tsantsan.
z-m-13-02.s.s2.hint.0: Duba ko za ka iya amfani da yadda 1/4 da 1/3 suke bayyana a matsayin decimal a matsayin shaida a saƙonka.
z-m-13-02.s.s2.hint.1: Ka gwada rubuta ta kashi biyu: 'Ya dace idan...' da 'A kula idan...'.
z-m-13-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Saƙon ya bayyana duka 'yaushe ya dace' da 'yaushe a kula'?
z-m-13-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Misalan kasron da ka bayar suna goyon bayan abin da ka faɗa?
z-m-13-02.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ka bambanta yanayin da ake buƙatar ainihin ƙima da inda kusan ƙima ta isa?
z-m-13-02.s.s2.model.0: Kasro da take zama decimal daidai, kamar 1/4 ko 1/5, har yanzu daidai ce idan aka sauya ta zuwa decimal domin lissafi. Amma 1/3 ita ce 0.333… tana ci gaba har abada, saboda haka rubuta 0.33 ƙiyasta ne. Idan ana buƙatar ainihin ƙima, yi lissafi da kasro.
z-m-13-02.s.s2.model.1: Idan matsalar tana buƙatar wurin decimal na biyu kaɗai, za ka iya rubuta 1/3 a matsayin 0.33. Amma idan ka haɗa 0.33 sau uku, 0.99 za ka samu, ba 1 ba; saboda haka yayin ci gaba da lissafi a kula da taruwar kuskure.

z-m-13-05.title: Raba sassa kafin rabawa: wace hanya ce ke aiki?
z-m-13-05.topic: Raba lambobi gauraye: za a iya raba ko wace lamba don yin lissafi?
z-m-13-05.goal: Kwatanta hanyoyi biyu na rarraba lambobi gauraye yayin lissafin rabo, amfani da shaidar tebur; bambanta abin da misalai suka nuna da abin da ba su nuna ba; bayyana dalilin da ya sa wata hanya ke aiki wata kuma ba ta aiki.
z-m-13-05.material:
Gaon da Narae sun bayyana hanyoyin raba sassa domin lissafin rabo na lambobi gauraye.
Gaon: "Raba lambar gauraye da ake rabawa zuwa ɓangaren cikakkiyar lamba da ɓangaren kasro, raba kowanne da mai rabawa, sannan a haɗa."
Narae: "Na raba mai rabawa, lambar gauraye, zuwa cikakkiyar lamba da ɓangaren kasro, in raba lambar da ake rabawa da kowanne, in haɗa."
Waɗannan sakamakon gwajin hanyoyinsu ne a matsaloli biyu. (2 1/2 ana karanta shi biyu da rabi, 12 1/2 kuma goma sha biyu da rabi.)

z-m-13-05.s.s1.r.c: Abin da aka raba ne ya bambanta. Gaon ya raba lambar da ake rabawa, Narae kuma mai rabawa.
